messages:
Sofia (Partnerships): FYI from this morning's GreenWave SI preflight: their RDMA NIC goes into kernel oops when our private image mounts VFIO devices. Customer wants go-live Fri 06:00 UTC but flagged stability risk. Need rapid triage + delivery options.
Priya (SI PM): Reproduced on their lab cluster. Nodes hang during kubelet start, dmesg shows VF_RDMA panic. They will not accept kernel downgrade.
Nora (Field Eng): Paste from their lab node:
```
[ 9876.543210] vf_rdma: BUG: trying to free nonexistent skb at 0xffff88807c2f1000
[ 9876.543215] Kernel panic - not syncing: Attempted to kill init!
[ 9876.543220] Call Trace: dump_stack+0x5c/0x81
```
Sofia (Partnerships): Image tag is rdw-private:2026-03-20-sha:ef12b9. They also run firmware v1.7.4 on NICs (Liam: any known issues?).
Liam (HW Partner): v1.7.x introduced a late DMA fix that can expose a race with VF drivers on newer kernels. We have a firmware 1.7.6 candidate that stabilizes DMA ordering. Can push to few test devices, but SI needs approval.
Ethan (SRE): Short-term mitigations we can prepare: 1) initramfs workaround to skip loading vf_rdma; 2) udev rule to bind a generic driver as fallback; 3) hosted-shim route to handle 100% of traffic for the customer during cutover.
Nora (Field Eng): Customer policy: no kernel or firmware changes without change window. They might accept an initramfs hotpatch. Also note their firewall blocks outbound telemetry except to our EU endpoints.
Sofia (Partnerships): Which should we prepare now? We need a recommended plan for SI and legal by 02:30 UTC.
Ethan (SRE): I'll try the initramfs blacklist in staging and boot 3 nodes. ETA 60m. If that passes, we sign a hotfix tarball. If it fails, we must have hosted-shim + canary ready.
Ops (Console): Opening ticket RDW-4762 (SI delivery) and RDW-4763 (hotfix build). Creating Console route: "greenwave.*" -> add traffic split capability. Link: <https://console.redwood.ai/docs/traffic-splitting|console traffic-split docs>.
deploy-bot: Deployment pipeline triggered: rdw-hotfix-greenwave-202603 -> build 1 started. :rocket:
Priya (SI PM): Can we add a telemetry tag on requests so GreenWave traces are grouped? Need logs for vendor and SI for RCA.
Ethan (SRE): Add tag "gw-rdma-v1" to traces and require zipkin/prometheus endpoints open (ports 9411, 9090). Nora confirm network egress rules.
Nora (Field Eng): Confirmed: SI will open egress to telemetry EU hosts. I'll prepare minimal runbook and rollback steps. Runbook snippet:
````
1) Upload hotfix tar: rdw-hotfix-greenwave-202603
2) ssh to node -> sudo tar xzf /tmp/hotfix.tar.gz -C /opt/rdw/hotfix
3) sudo chroot /opt/rdw/hotfix update-initramfs -k all -u
4) reboot node and verify: journalctl -b | grep vf_rdma -> no stack traces
5) If still failing: shift traffic to hosted-shim via Console route split (Ops)
````
Liam (HW Partner): We'll fast-track firmware 1.7.6 testing but it will take ~48h to certify. If hotfix is accepted we can plan firmware rollout post-cutover.
Sofia (Partnerships): OK. Next steps: Ethan to post staging result in this thread; Nora to attach runbook + port confirmation; Ops to create canary route and tickets. Priya to update customer and request canary approval.
Ethan (SRE): On it. Paging SRE rotation for visibility. @deploy-bot page-oncall.
deploy-bot: PagerDuty: paging SRE rotation 1 (incident: rdw-greenwave-rdma). Assigned: Ethan (SRE).
Sofia (Partnerships): Thanks team. We should also loop Legal for the diagnostic logs DPA - I'll ping Legal separately. :white_check_mark:
